captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a live rear axle assembly featuring a central, rounded differential housing and two extending axle tubes. A metallic grey pinion input shaft projects perpendicularly from the front of the differential housing, terminating in a black flange. At each outer end of the dark grey axle tubes, a flared black wheel hub is mounted on a light grey bearing ring. The pinion shaft and both wheel hubs are designed to rotate continuously relative to the fixed axle housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a live rear axle assembly with a central differential housing, two lateral axle tubes, and a perpendicular input pinion shaft. The main housing should be dark grey, with a metallic grey pinion shaft and light grey bearing rings supporting black, flared wheel hubs. Define continuous rotational joints for the input pinion shaft and both wheel hubs.
captions.factory: Construct the main axle housing as a single rigid part by combining a central sphere (differential housing), cylindrical axle tubes, and auxiliary mounting brackets using union operations. Model the input pinion shaft using nested cylinders of varying diameters and attach it via a continuous rotational joint. Model the wheel hubs at each end using lofted or combined cylindrical and conical primitives, and mount them to the axle tubes with continuous rotational joints aligned to the transverse axis.
